notes.title: Casina - Update v1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are back with another announcement, this time introducing our [h3]Patch 1.1[/h3].
Since Casina's launch we have been [b]closely reading all your reviews and feedback[/b]! We put everything together in a big list and here we are with a new fresh update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/cbb5c0997dfd33af04e7b98c5e2d5c1b3ff23115.jpg[/img]
[h3]
Patch Notes:[/h3]
[i]- [b]Fixed the non-working windowed option[/b]
- Now the game fully supports multiple screen resolutions! You will be able to adjust your game window as you like!
- Choices now display a black text color (more readable)
- Fixed missing Alcesimus name in the textbox
- [b]Fixed all the save/loading problems after Act 3[/b] (you need to delete your old saves by clicking on the "Reset Progress button" in options.
- Added missing lore entry for the Italian version of the game
- Fixed UI related bugs for the Chinese version of the game
- Many improvements to the German version of the game
- Improvements to our animation system and character expressions
- The game is more stable when alt-tabbing[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/aeb4563e53b64e00856a687e3e993113c771ec02.jpg[/img]

We are still working on a few other improvements but we really wanted to publish this update as soon as possible.
Thanks for the awesome support and keep sending us feedback via private message or review!

notes.title: Demo 2.0 and preparing for Full Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
We are incredibly close to Release! Actually the full game will be available in just 3 days!

I must admit we worked really hard on this game, we learned how to fully animate and fully voice a Visual Novel, it was quite challenging but we finally reached the finish line!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263608/878f1ec3e03a748cdd4d8a2c0df7c14fbe7715fc.jpg[/img]

[b]During the last few months we spent our time improving a lot of stuff, many of which are also available in our Demo:[/b]
[i]- Many improvements to our Visual Novel engine
- Improved animated character models, (characters feature more expressions, emotes and stances)
- Improved artworks transition flow
- Added custom screen shake effect
- Added the encyclopedia
- Codex can be automatically showed in-game or disabled
- Added a cute "codex unlocked" icon
- Added many Sfx to the game 
- Added a new game trailer
- Fully localized the game in Portuguese - Brazilian Portuguese
- Fully localized the game in Turkish
- Many bug fixes and more.[/i]


Lastly we really want to personally thank everyone who supported, helped and worked with us during development.

[b]You are awesome![/b]

Also if you can, help us spread the word about our game. Tell your friends, send an email to your favorite reviewer or do nothing! Everything is appreciated ^^
[b]See you in a couple of days with the Game Release![/b]
